> > Fact From Story Google gave Spotify a 0 percent fee and let them process their own payments, while making other developers pay much higher fees.
> > > Fact From Story Google pays actual and potential competitors not to compete.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Paying off competitors is illegal.
> > Fact From Story Epic wants to break up Google’s alleged monopoly on Android app stores and payment methods, so developers aren’t stuck paying the “Google Tax” or passing
> > > Fact From Story Google requires apps to use its own first-party billing system, and charges app developers a 15% to 30% commission on the sales it processes.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Charging a percentage on sales is a fee.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Companies with monopolies can charge unfair fees.
> Commonsense Knowledge A lawsuit is when one party sues another.
